Synopsis:
Russia has extended its diesel export ban through September 30, also covering marine fuel and gas oils. The ban stems from domestic fuel shortages caused by Ukrainian drone strikes on refineries. Russia — normally the world's second-largest diesel exporter — has staggered bans across fuel types extending into 2027, tightening global diesel supply.
